description: Runs the same RSS → social posts flow as the Flomixy app (its "AI variants") for an article already in a connected feed: one post per target network, with a caption and the article link, plus the feed image only when the feed has feed images turned on and the item has one (Instagram and TikTok get "Link in bio" instead of the URL, Google Business Profile puts it on its button; a feed image that could not be imported is reported as `imageSkipReason`; no `imageSkipReason` does not prove an image was attached). Each `created` entry has `source`: `ai` = AI-written caption; `template` = NOT AI-written, a ready-made caption built from the article's own title or text (possibly with a stock question), used when AI is unavailable, the monthly AI quota is used up or AI generation fails; the title and text are not translated into `language`, and the result does not say which cause it was. If `source` is `template`, tell the user. Never publishes directly: without scheduledAt the posts stay DRAFTS; with scheduledAt they are scheduled but still wait for human approval. Pick times with get_best_times / get_next_free_slot. Must be at least 10 minutes from now, otherwise SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON (not retryable; the error names the earliest allowed time). Get feedId/itemId from list_rss_feeds and accountId from list_accounts. An `ai` caption uses one AI caption unit; a `template` caption uses none. Networks that cannot be generated (duplicate caption, account not owned by the feed's brand, or the article is already posted/scheduled/drafted on that very account: reason ALREADY_POSTED with `existingPostId` and `existingStatus`) come back in `skipped`, not as an error; no AI unit is spent for them. Use `force` only if the user wants another post anyway. A scheduled network that needs an image the article cannot supply (MISSING_MEDIA), or that cannot publish an image at all such as YouTube (FAILED), is also in `skipped` with a `message` and no AI unit spent, while the other posts ARE created: report both to the user and do not request the created ones again. If the feed image's aspect ratio is found, before captions are written, to be outside what a scheduled network accepts (Instagram accepts 0.8 to 1.91), the whole call fails with MEDIA_ASPECT_RATIO and no post is created: tell the user, then call again without that network's scheduledAt. If the image is rejected only later, that network is in `skipped` with reason MEDIA_ASPECT_RATIO and a `message` (an AI unit may already be spent on the skipped one), while the posts in `created` exist: report both, do not request the created ones again, and retry only the skipped network without scheduledAt. In both cases replace the image of that draft with update_post. Bluesky captions, drafts included, are shortened to fit 300 graphemes including the article link whenever the link leaves room for at least 20 graphemes of text (the link is kept, the cut text ends with "…"). This result does not include the caption or say whether it was cut: to show the user the saved text of a created post, call get_post with its postId (`caption`; a non-null `targets[].caption` replaces it for that network; needs scope POSTS_READ). With less room than that, a scheduled Bluesky target is in `skipped` with reason FAILED and a `message`, with no AI unit spent: relay the message to the user. As a draft it is not skipped, but its text is not shortened, and if it is over 300 graphemes it must be brought within the limit before it can be scheduled. An invalid scheduledAt on any target rejects the whole call before any caption is generated, and no post is created: in the past (errors.post.scheduledInPast), too soon (SCHEDULED_TOO_SOON) or beyond the scheduling horizon, 365 days by default (errors.post.scheduledTooFar). Tell the user the error and ask for a new time; do not silently drop or change it. Requires scope POSTS_WRITE.

approverId.description: Workspace member who should review the posts (list_approvers).

force.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly wants another post for an article that already has one on the account. Default false: such networks come back in `skipped` with reason ALREADY_POSTED.

itemId.description: Item id from list_rss_feeds. Exactly one of itemId / itemUrl.

itemUrl.description: Link of an article already in the feed (e.g. the blog URL). Exactly one of itemId / itemUrl.

targets.description: One post is generated per entry.

accountId.description: Connected account id (list_accounts). It must belong to the brand of the feed.

channel.description: Network of the account, canonically UPPERCASE (e.g. FACEBOOK); lowercase is accepted.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 WITH timezone offset. Omit to leave this network's post as a draft.

name: generate_posts_from_rss_item
title: Generate social posts from an RSS / blog item
